statements.t: Our CRAs with a leading frontier AI lab and our new $424 million bridge facility have significantly reduced the near-term financing and supply chain risk on the equipment for two significant data center projects we are currently negotiating.

Our first behind-the-meter project in Socorro, Texas, remains on track to come online at the end of the first quarter of next year, and it shows what Atlas does best: build quickly, operate reliably, and deploy power where it’s needed.
As expected, that reduced our third quarter sales volumes.

Our commercial team has since backfilled those volumes for the fourth quarter and, with line of sight to more than 23 million allocated tons for 2027, we expect sequential improvement across all of our business lines during the fourth quarter.”
The Company is providing financial guidance for the fourth quarter of 2026.
Looking ahead to the fourth quarter, we expect sequential improvement in every segment of our business.
For the fourth quarter, we currently expect Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $40 million to $50 million.
An archived version of the conference call will be available on the Company’s website shortly after the conclusion of the call.
